NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: We could not find the page you were looking for.

Calendar.title: Available dates
Calendar.intro: Pick a day to see its times, then book a free one.
Calendar.callSlot: Call us to book the {time} slot
Calendar.whatsappSlot: Message us on WhatsApp to book the {time} slot
Calendar.slotsFree: {count, plural, =0 {No free slots} one {1 free slot} other {# free slots}}
Calendar.noSlotsTitle: The venue is not available on this day
Calendar.noSlotsBody: Pick another day from the calendar, or contact us if you have a question.
Calendar.errorBody: Check your internet connection and try again. You can also book by phone.

Unavailable.title: We're temporarily unavailable
Unavailable.description: Something went wrong on our side. You can still reach the venue directly to book.

Login.title: Staff login
Login.invalid: The login or password is incorrect.
Login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
Login.failed: Could not log in. Check your connection and try again.

Verification.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No attempts left} one {1 attempt left} other {# attempts left}}
Verification.errorExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
Verification.errorTooMany: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
Verification.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Verification.deliveryTitle: We cannot send codes right now
Verification.deliveryBody: Please contact the venue to book by phone or WhatsApp.

Dashboard.welcomeHint: Booking tools will appear here as they are built.

settings.title: Venue settings
settings.occasionsHint: Each occasion has one price, whatever the slot. A deactivated occasion is no longer offered; existing bookings keep their price.
settings.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? It will no longer be offered. Existing bookings keep their price and are unaffected.
settings.depositHint: Between 1 and 100. Rounded to whole EGP for each booking.
settings.cutoffHint: A slot starting sooner than this cannot be held online.
settings.urgentHint: A hold on a slot starting within this time is flagged urgent.
settings.noPayment: No payment method is set. Bookings cannot be taken until you add at least one.
settings.paymentWarning: Changing these while holds are active means some customers may already have paid to the old details.
settings.settingsSaved: Settings saved. They apply to new bookings.
settings.invalid: Check the fields: names are required, prices are whole numbers, and the deposit is between 1 and 100.

staff.title: Staff
staff.empty: Add staff who can confirm payments and enter bookings.
staff.name: Name
staff.confirmDisable: Disable {name}? Their open sessions end immediately.
staff.passwordReset: Password reset. Their open sessions ended.
staff.lastOwner: There must always be one active owner.
staff.invalid: Check the fields: the login uses letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores (3 to 32), and the password needs at least 8 characters.

schedule.title: Slot schedule
schedule.emptyPattern: Add the times the venue can be booked. Use Add slot on each day.
schedule.slotCount: {count, plural, =0 {No slots} one {1 slot} other {# slots}}
schedule.patternSaved: Schedule saved. Existing bookings keep their times.

problem.empty: Enter a start and an end time.
problem.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
problem.overlap: This slot overlaps another slot on the same day.

schedule.invalid: Check the slots: each must end after it starts, and slots on one day may not overlap.
schedule.slotsRequired: Add at least one slot, or close the date.
schedule.dateInvalid: Choose today or a later date.
schedule.conflictTitle: Nothing was saved: active bookings use these times.
schedule.conflictHint: Cancel these bookings or wait until they have passed, then try again.
schedule.confirmRemove: Remove the exception for {date}? The date returns to the weekly pattern.
